question: How is the constant washing of the mouth symbolically interpreted in this teaching?
premises: Washing of the mouth is prescribed as constant.
It is described as having gone upward to Brahman.
The instruction is addressed to the beloved.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as rising upward to Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of mukha-prakṣālana in this context is interpretive.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
